title: PasswordResetRequest
description: Payload submitted when a user requests a password reset link

email.description: The registered email address for the account. The response must be identical regardless of whether this address is registered.

PasswordResetConfirmation.title: PasswordResetConfirmation
PasswordResetConfirmation.description: Payload submitted when a user sets a new password after clicking the reset link

token.description: Single-use, cryptographically random reset token delivered via email link

newPassword.description: The replacement password chosen by the user
